text:
Ava Chen: Pinging product/design for a quick pass on the autoscale controls UI — focus: SLO slider default, min/max labeling, and burst wording.
Liam Patel: +1. Current default reliability is too high; new users get surprised when min increases. Propose soft default 70%.
Sofi Gomez: Accessibility flag: pool picker traps focus after close on VoiceOver. Also some cards lack unique aria-labels. Must fix.
Marco Rivera: Users keep asking if "burst" is permanent. Suggest either: label as 'Burst (temporary)' or add helper: 'Extra GPUs for short spikes — auto-removes'.
Ellie Tran: Fallback toast is confusing. "Fallback active" doesn't explain routing or perf. Draft: "Fallback active: selected pool full. Routing to Redwood Hosted; data encrypted in transit. Reserve capacity to avoid routing. (Details)"
Ava Chen: Nice. Also thinking we should show a tiny cost delta inline with the SLO slider and a small sparkline under min/max when min=0 + burst=true to illustrate cold-start risk.
Liam Patel: I'll prototype the $/hr delta and the sparkline. Keep it subtle.
Sofi Gomez: For the slider add aria-valuetext like: 'Reliability 70 percent. Higher reliability may increase cost.' Ensure condensed visual copy has hidden verbose text for screen readers.
Marco Rivera: I'll post two microcopy variants for burst + slider hint by EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy: autoscale-ui-v2 -> staging at 2024-11-06T16:22Z. Please verify keyboard and screen reader flows.
Ellie Tran: Action list: Marco + Ava update copy, Liam mock cost UI, Sofi run a11y pass, Ellie draft fallback modal. Target: staging review next Thursday.
Ava Chen: Thanks team — will update Figma and link here when ready. :sparkles:
